quint.scope: One owner and two successive helper generations; split data/control stores and permits, callback debt, borrows, reader pins, lost acquisition/result response and GC scan. Real noescape/termination and root registration are external witnesses; bounded sampling, not C/ISA or liveness proof

lean.scope: Selective per-generation closure, stale receipt rejection, reader/borrow/debt guards, root retention and result-custody laws; not whole QNT induction, C/ISA or Gambit source simulation
